symbolDescription: Where the camera looks from. Every member is optional wherever a pose is accepted.

optionDescriptions.lat: Latitude the camera is centred over, in degrees. Clamped to ±85.
optionDescriptions.lng: Longitude the camera is centred over, in degrees.
optionDescriptions.zoom: Distance from the globe centre in globe radii, clamped to [minZoom, maxZoom]. Smaller is closer.
optionDescriptions.tilt: Degrees away from the surface normal at the centred point, clamped to 0–75.
